disclaimer: Offline preparation + fixture-verified pilot runner only. Does not purchase CryptoStruct data, spend credits, place orders, or claim independent confirmation. All M16-ER pilot days remain exploratory SPENT. M12.8 Coinbase→Kalshi lead-lag already classified no-directional-response on KalshiBot live-capture TOB; this pilot tests a different data plane (CryptoStruct tick books + explicit delay scenarios) and does not reopen M14/M16.
hypothesis: After an external Coinbase BTC-USD move, Kalshi KXBTC15M executable quotes may adjust slowly enough that a delayed taker entry remains profitable after STANDARD fees and a fixed short hold.

priorResearchAlreadyAnswered.artifactHint: train-selected-run-lead-lag-analysis.json (KalshiBot live-capture Coinbase spot → Kalshi TOB)
priorResearchAlreadyAnswered.note: A statistical lead on the live-capture plane does not authorize a tradable edge. This pilot is allowed only as a different data-plane / delay-scenario check on CryptoStruct tick books; it is not a revival of M14 momentum or M16 reversal.

externalVenue.rationale: Preferred by prompt when matched trade/BBO coverage exists. Catalog: 997 days, covers all 34 M16-ER days, trades + L2 book + BBO stream. Binance Spot BTCUSD is ~200× smaller/day but was not chosen: Coinbase is the stated preference and has adequate coverage for the overlapping M16-ER window.

kalshiSeries.note: Use raw book/trade updates from retained M16-ER ZIPs — not the 60s friction grid.

daySelection.universe: 34 SPENT M16-ER days with local RAW ZIPs

eventDefinition.series: Coinbase BTC-USD mid from reconstructed BBO (fallback: last trade)
eventDefinition.trigger: absolute lookback return crosses 5 bps from below (boundary cross)
eventDefinition.normalization: basis points vs lookback start price
eventDefinition.thresholdSource: Frozen from M12.8 MAGNITUDE_BOUNDARIES_BPS lower cell (5 bps); not estimated on pilot P&L

kalshiContractSelection.rule: Among KXBTC15M contracts whose [start,expiry) contains eventTimestampMs, pick the one with YES mid closest to 50¢ (ATM); ties → earlier expiry

timing.eventClock: exchangeTimestamp when non-zero; else adapterTimestamp with timestampSource=adapter
timing.joinClock: same policy on both legs; causal as-of only (last observation ≤ decision time)
timing.delaySemantics: Scenario assumptions for when a bot would act after observing the external event — not measured production latency
timing.subsecondClaimPolicy: Do not claim a subsecond opportunity if timing quality cannot support it; 250 ms remains a reported sensitivity, not a claim of synchronized clocks

execution.entry: taker buy of directional side at ask after delay
execution.exit: taker sell at bid after fixed hold

positionPolicy.eventDedup: one primary event per boundary-cross per lookback stream; cooldown applies

controls.signFlip: trade opposite side of primary direction (diagnostic)
controls.timeSham: for each primary event, place a sham event at eventTimestamp − 2×hold − delay with same magnitude metadata but no directional claim (diagnostic)
controls.note: Controls are diagnostic only — not additional strategy searches.

primaryMetric.name: mean net P&L ¢/contract at primary delay
primaryMetric.uncertainty: CR2 cluster-robust SE by UTC day; two-sided 95% Student-t CI, df=G−1

stopExpandCriteria.stopIf: primary-delay mean ≤ 0, or CI entirely ≤ 0, or timing quality blocks ≤1s claims and 1s/3s means are nonpositive
stopExpandCriteria.expandOnlyIf: primary-delay mean > 0 with CI entirely > 0 on exploratory SPENT — still requires a separate preregistered fresh-period design before any confirmation claim
